hero.headline: Let's Work Together in Kenya and Beyond.
hero.title: Careers.
hero.description: SmartGrid Surveying is a professional geospatial and engineering firm delivering precision land surveying, UAV mapping, GIS, underground utility detection, and civil infrastructure solutions. We seek disciplined, technically competent professionals committed to accuracy, safety, and excellence in project delivery.

currentOpenings.headline: Current Opportunities
currentOpenings.description: Explore the open positions below and apply to become part of our growing team.

featuredOpenings.title: Project Manager
featuredOpenings.description: Lead project planning, resource coordination, reporting, and delivery of multidisciplinary surveying and civil works assignments.

items.title: Project Manager
items.description: Lead project planning, resource coordination, reporting, and delivery of multidisciplinary surveying and civil works assignments.

items.title: Civil Engineer
items.description: Supervise and coordinate civil works execution, ensuring compliance with design specifications, quality standards, and safety protocols.

items.title: Land Surveyor
items.description: Lead topographical, boundary, cadastral, and engineering surveys supporting infrastructure and construction projects with high accuracy standards.

items.title: Engineering Survey Technician
items.description: Support site setting-out, control establishment, as-built surveys, and alignment verification using GNSS and total station equipment.

items.title: UAV / Drone Survey Specialist
items.description: Execute aerial mapping, photogrammetry, and LiDAR data acquisition for corridor mapping, volumetrics, and infrastructure monitoring.

items.title: GIS & Spatial Data Analyst
items.description: Develop spatial databases, conduct geospatial analysis, and produce professional cartographic outputs for donor and infrastructure projects.

items.title: Construction Site Supervisor
items.description: Oversee daily construction activities, workforce coordination, progress tracking, and compliance with project timelines.

items.title: Quantity Surveyor
items.description: Prepare BOQs, cost estimates, valuations, and financial tracking reports for civil and infrastructure projects.

items.title: Underground Utilities & GPR Technician
items.description: Conduct underground utility detection, mapping, and documentation using GPR and electromagnetic locating systems.

items.title: HSE Officer
items.description: Ensure strict adherence to occupational health, safety, environmental safeguards, and compliance standards across project sites.

items.title: Graduate Interns & Industrial Attachés (Surveying, GIS, Civil)
items.description: Opportunities for students and recent graduates to gain practical field and office experience in surveying, geospatial analysis, and civil works projects.

applicationProcess.subtitle: Application Process
applicationProcess.description:
Submit your CV and cover letter to <bold>info@smartgridsurveying.com<bold> indicating the position applied for in the subject line.

 Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted. SmartGrid Surveying is an equal opportunity employer committed to professionalism, integrity, and excellence.

statement.subtitle: Equal Opportunity & Donor Compliance Statement
statement.description: SmartGrid Surveying & Civil Works Ltd is an equal opportunity employer. Recruitment and employment decisions are made without discrimination based on gender, ethnicity, religion, disability, or background. We are committed to compliance with applicable national labor laws and donor-funded project requirements, including World Bank, UN, and development partner standards on ethics, safeguarding, and professional conduct.
